overview.value: This special episode consists of three different stories: in 'Yes, This is a 1% Miracle', Haruna goes to a festival to find it deserted and so everyone pitches in to make a lively festival by holding a contest with Sera and Eu as the prizes. In 'Welcome to the Danger Zone', Sera tries her hand at cooking, and in 'The One Day the Floor Gets Hit Most', the school holds a contest on nursery rhymes and Ayumu is repeatedly probed in a very uncomfortable area!

This special episode contains two stories: in 'The Value of a Swimsuit is Priceless', Ayumu tries to keep the peace as Haruna scours the local pool for signs of a sea monster. In 'No I’m a Virgo Woman', the necromancer’s birthday celebration is disrupted by a demonic void.
Haruna accidentally sells a philosopher’s stone, Ayumu becomes temporarily invisible, and a bevy of scantily clad beauties are about to be unwittingly gazed upon by the eyes of a zombie!
